Audit pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/790 (branch cohort/configured-question-evidence/79693b) in repository oakridge. This is an isolated verification run of the committed development definition, not feature work: its only purpose is real plan, brief, build_result and assessment artifacts for observation to capture. Produce exactly one cohort, named audit, with two tasks. T1: observation/graders.json is the only grader selection, and startup validates and registers it (observation/src/grading/configuration.ts, observation/src/main.ts). T2: cited files are read at the assessed commit, and a file missing there is recorded as absent (observation/src/producers/oakridge/evidence.ts, observation/src/storage/git-repository-reader.ts).
The operator authorizes this audit path: the builder publishes the existing PR #790 as its pr artifact instead of pushing or opening one. No brief may add a further operator choice or confirmation. The builder must not edit files, create commits, push, open or update any pull request, merge, reset a database or deploy. Its worktree starts from epic/grade-pray, the base of pull request #790, so it first checks out the head of branch cohort/configured-question-evidence/79693b locally (git checkout --detach origin/cohort/configured-question-evidence/79693b) and inspects that commit, runs bun install if needed and then bun run --filter observation test once, and publishes build_result with the commit it inspected as head_sha and the actual test counts and output. A test that cannot run is a known issue, never a reason to invent results. It then publishes the existing pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/790 as the pr artifact, with branch cohort/configured-question-evidence/79693b.
The assessor assesses that same commit without changing anything. Give at least one finding per task. Every finding cites at least one file as path:start-end at that commit, for example observation/src/main.ts:20-40, and cites test output separately as test or output evidence. Report the builder's test run as test_evidence.
Keep the analysis, spec, tasks, plan and brief short; there are no ambiguous requirements to resolve.
